events.evidence: Eurozone leaders agree on a bailout deal for Greece providing the Hellenic Parliament passes reforms into law by July 15
An airstrike by the Saudi-led coalition kills 25 civilians and wounds 50 in Sanaa, the capital of Yemen. Last week a ceasefire agreement was reached
Burundi's army kills 31 suspected rebels and captures 170 others in fighting in the country's north

label.note: Conditional Greek bailout reduces euro tail risk; Yemen ceasefire breach and Africa fighting temper.
